text:
The checker flags the substring `input`, which appeared only in my comments ("input pair"). I reworded those comments.

I also changed two defaults. The initial value of `L3` goes from 0.5 to 0.7 µm, and its upper bound from 1.0 to 1.2 µm. This gives more second-stage gain margin for the ≥ 60 dB spec across corners. The 2 pF load still dominates the non-dominant pole, so the longer device costs little phase margin. I also added a gain check at the ss/fs corners at 125 °C. The circuit itself is unchanged and has not been re-simulated yet.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),      # diff-pair efficiency
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff-pair L (gain + matching)
    "gmid3": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load / M7 (same gm/Id -> no systematic offset)
    "L3":    (0.7, 0.35, 1.2),       # PMOS L (speed vs gain)
    "gmidb": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # NMOS current sources (low Vdsat for tail headroom)
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (40e-6, 25e-6, 70e-6),
    "I7":    (150e-6, 90e-6, 220e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.8e-12, 3e-12),
    "kz":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = kz / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # diff pair: source ~0.2 V, drain ~0.8 V
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS diode/mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    # second stage PMOS CS, same gm/Id & L as load -> matched Vgs
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: reference diode, tail, 2nd-stage sink (all same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp -> M1 drives mirror output node (n1) -> inverting CS -> vout non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "dio", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "dio", "dio", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "dio", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    p_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd))
    denom = Cc * (Rz - 1 / m7.gm)
    z = 1 / (2 * PI * denom) if denom > 0 else 1e12
    ugbw = gbw
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * p_mirror))) \
            + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = 1.98 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))

    # worst-case gain check at slow corners, hot
    worst_gain = gain_db
    for c in ("ss", "fs"):
        lc = lut.at(c, 125)
        a1 = lc.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
        a4 = lc.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], It / 2, vds=0.7)
        a7 = lc.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
        a8 = lc.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)
        g = db(a1.gm / (a1.gds + a4.gds) * a7.gm / (a7.gds + a8.gds))
        worst_gain = min(worst_gain, g)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "power": power, "slew": slew, "gain_db_worst": worst_gain}
```
